nodes.title: Important notices
widgets_values:
Note 1: The edit triggers section is only if you want to edit the trigger words from each lora to change any of them for the image generation, but if you don't wanna change them, just bypass the edit triggers group or put the value "false" on each "switch string" nodes.

Note 2: if you wana change the lora and edit the triggers, you MUST to delete the former trigger words from the last lora and run the "edit triggers" nodes after changing the loras.

Note 3: You must install these custom nodes for the workflow to function correctly

https://github.com/vergil-sparda0701/ComfyUI-LoraLoaderPreview.git
https://github.com/vergil-sparda0701/ComfyUI-EditableShowText.git
https://github.com/vergil-sparda0701/ComfyUI-AnimaRegional.git
https://github.com/vergil-sparda0701/comfyui-apply-signature

these custom nodes above don't appear on comfyUI manager, that's why i put the links here, the other custom nodes used on this workflow you can install them with ComfyUI Manager
